title: betula chinensis var. fargesii
intro: Betula chinensis var. fargesii, commonly known as Farges' Birch, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Betulaceae family. The bark, leaves, and roots of this plant have been used in traditional Chinese medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Farges' Birch include immune system support, wound healing, and fever reduction, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
